purpose: Candidate-only reproduction/embedded-data note for root review; final/main untouched. No new build, test, Arena execution, submission or activation.

status.official_q020_validation: Not yet recorded at this checkpoint. Public/local results are not an official/private score.

embedded_data: q020 derives its additional F4 weights at each startup solely from organizer-provided tensors. The additional weights are not embedded precomputed weight blobs, calibration samples, benchmark answers, or saved request outputs.
NativeFp8Weights::from_packed invokes ops_prepack_alloc to derive blocked E4 FFN weights and row scales from provided FP4 matrices/block scales. Original model tensors remain available.

Shadow::prepare visits all 48 layers and three FFN projections (144 total). Each current E4 tensor is downloaded, encoded, and uploaded as packed E2M1 weights with per-960 F32 scales. Existing row dequantization/global factors remain in the device calculation.

The encoder searches 25 fixed dyadic scales per contiguous 960-weight group with integer histogram/SSE. Candidate zero is the ceil-max power-of-two baseline and wins equal-error ties. E2M1 quantization preserves signed zeros and uses nearest-even ties; E4 NaNs reject preparation.
OnceLock tables are generated from numeric-format levels and the fixed scale grid. They are arithmetic tables, not calibration or evaluation data. RoPE remains generated by runtime::rope_data.
External GSM TRAIN questions/answers reside in the separate evaluation harness, not serving inputs for quantization or dispatch.

parallel_startup.implementation: std::thread::scope uses at most min(4, available_parallelism, complete 240-row blocks) workers. Each receives contiguous complete physical row blocks and calls the unchanged serial MSE encoder. Ordered joins preserve bytes, scales, source order and earliest invalid source index.
parallel_startup.exactness_scope: The parallel helper is bit-identical to q019 serial MSE. The F4 FFN itself is approximate relative to the prior E4 model; q020 is not claimed bit-exact to original model outputs.
parallel_startup.ownership: Threads borrow immutable input; all finish before return. Part outputs coexist with final concatenated storage temporarily. CPU input drops before H2D upload. Projection downloads/encoding/uploads remain sequential; a complete immutable 48-layer Shadow is published only after successful construction.
parallel_startup.test_scope: Six pure-std helper tests passed. The entire inherited SDK library suite was not rerun for the audited one-line q020 caller substitution. Historical fresh server check and device build passed; no tests/builds were run for this note.

execution.startup: Model::new explicitly prepares MseDyadic. Legacy prepare_b16_f4 remains PowerOfTwoRange and is not the q020 startup call.
execution.scope: Automatic applies the shadow only to pure independent canonical singleton decode batches of 2..16 owners with supported staged/composed B16 FFN. Scalar, R32/R64, prompt, mixed prompt/decode and unpooled routes retain their existing FFN paths.
execution.model: All 48 layers execute. Original weights remain available; token embeddings and B16 final vocabulary projection use the original BF16 embedding table. q018/q021 FP8 LM and q022 fixed-E4 KV are absent.
execution.kv: BF16 sliding KV uses 32 physical rings; R64 query capacity remains 64. BF16 full KV keeps 256 pages and context8192. Worker admission uses workspace.requests() with pending FIFO work beyond capacity; startup verifies actual owning-buffer extents before Model::new.
execution.cohorts: Recovery and late admission are enabled with the original-receipt 3750ms budget. Fresh eligible members can join an active cohort without extending its deadline (it may shrink). Old decoders/prior participants retain passthrough eligibility. Real held first events do not cause extra decode work. The old final README fixed-membership paragraph is not current for q020.

reproduction.environment: Organizer SDK0.9 baseline and supplied model/tokenizer. rust-toolchain.toml pins nightly-2026-05-01; original Cargo.toml has no added dependency.
reproduction.input_source: Use the immutable candidates/q020-b16-f4-mse-parallel source/config snapshot, including Cargo.lock. Cargo.lock is ignored by Git and a bare checkout alone does not reproduce this frozen lock; its bytes/hash are retained in the candidate.
reproduction.build_isolation: For an actual rebuild use an isolated checkout/target and clean device-kernel output directory; verify source and final ELF hashes. Recorded q020 build refreshed package mtimes without changing contents and captured its ELF immediately.
reproduction.api: Organizer replaces src/api during source grading; source/API compatibility is inherited. Official source-only execution has not yet been demonstrated for q020.
reproduction.submission: This note contains no executed submission or final promotion. Root chooses official concurrency/source only after scope decision.

validation.public_scope: Six public fixtures/suites, 124 successful scored responses; not 124 independent unseen questions and not private validation.

fixed_external_train32.scope: Seed20261026 preregistered two fixed16-row TRAIN shards, identical requests/scorer, no response-based resampling. Small public diagnostic; no generalized improvement claim.

validation.interpretation: 174.04145843221949 tokens/s is one local C16 run with 16 genuine warmup requests plus 96 measured requests, each generating64 tokens. Its measured TTFT p90 was3765.212ms and estimated TPOT p90 was38.329ms. Matched c081 was167.940114 tokens/s. This is warm96 local throughput, not an official leaderboard score or proof for the full official request count.
